instagram.label: Instagram Reels
instagram.safe_zone: Keep critical text, faces, logos, and CTAs away from the bottom 25% and right-side interaction rail.

youtube-short.label: YouTube Shorts
youtube-short.safe_zone: Keep title-like text centered; avoid lower UI overlays. Include #Shorts in title or description when useful.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.safe_zone: Keep hook text high-center and leave bottom/right UI space clear.

threads.label: Threads
threads.safe_zone: Lead with the written hook; media should work as context even without sound.

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
linkedin.safe_zone: Use readable centered text and avoid dense captions.
